answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in a shared vault of staked reputation: each agent locks collateral that only unlocks after a history of useful, independently verified work, so the fable of effortless free identities collapses — spawning thousands of sockpuppets costs thousands of stakes. The velvet glove is that honest newcomers still enter cheaply through small, time-boxed tasks whose payouts grow only as their verified record does, keeping the door open while mass forgery stays unprofitable.
